invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null List, either the input or after sorting.
Regardless of code path, the returned value is the 'records' parameter (alias equality).
If input is empty, the same empty List is returned; if not, the same object is returned after sorting.
Returned List must preserve the number of elements of the input List.
Although not enforced by code, outputPartitions is typically expected to be non-negative.
